chars.WIJDANE: WIJDANE: a 25-year-old Moroccan widow with long dark wavy hair, wearing a mustard-yellow long wool coat over a black turtleneck, small gold hoop earrings
chars.AYOUB: AYOUB: a 28-year-old Moroccan man raised in France, short faded haircut and neat trimmed beard, wearing a black leather jacket over a light-grey hoodie, white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Tangier courthouse hallway, WIJDANE and AYOUB stand face to face a few steps apart, staring at each other with tense, suspicious expressions, a court clerk holding papers between them, Moroccan arches and tiles in the background

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AYOUB walks out of Tangier airport arrivals pulling a black suitcase, serious determined face, sunglasses pushed up on his head, palm trees and taxis behind him

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: WIJDANE walks nervously into a Moroccan courtroom with wooden benches and a judge's bench with a Moroccan flag, clutching her handbag, worried eyes

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the courtroom, WIJDANE sits on a wooden bench and turns her head in surprise as AYOUB confidently walks in through the tall wooden door

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Across the courtroom, AYOUB stares intensely at WIJDANE with an unreadable look, while she glances back shyly and confused, other people blurred around them

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the sunny courthouse steps outside, AYOUB catches WIJDANE's wrist from behind, she turns around startled with wide eyes, he looks at her calmly

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: On the courthouse steps WIJDANE and AYOUB shake hands awkwardly, she raises an eyebrow in disbelief, he gives a charming half smile

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: AYOUB hands his smartphone to WIJDANE so she can type her number, she hesitates with a small embarrassed smile, a Tangier street with parked cars behind them

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: AYOUB winks playfully while walking away backwards, WIJDANE stands holding her phone to her chest, blushing and biting her lip, golden afternoon light
